description: This file is the entry point for a React application, importing the main React library, ReactDOM for DOM rendering, global CSS styling, and the main App component. It initializes the React root and renders the App component wrapped in StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root container for rendering the React application.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders React components into the DOM, specifically rendering the App component wrapped in React.StrictMode.
